pick.headline: Military coup overthrows Haiti's President Aristide
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of September 30, 1991, carried Havana's Radio Rebelde and Radio Reloj on gunfire outside Aristide's residence, soldiers seizing the state radio director after he reported a possible coup, and Aristide's whereabouts unknown.

alternates.headline: Zakharov freed in the Daniloff exchange
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of October 1, 1986, carried three TASS flashes of September 30: Reagan and Gorbachev to meet in Reykjavik on October 11-12, Zakharov released and returning home, and Daniloff "expelled" on September 29.
